rejection_reasons: Three candidates used a C-Tech category relationship inconsistent with the final environment or text.
At least two printer-wide candidates hid a third background collection outside the declared visual signature; three more used ambiguous furniture counting.
Twenty-seven candidates added explicit light not present in the declared reference without recording that addition in ctech_changes; thirteen incorrectly claimed the lighting was retained.
The host validator checked score bands and self-reported inventories but did not yet enforce same-environment close adaptations or complete change provenance.
next_revision: Require exact, minimal-camera-edit and close-adaptation candidates to preserve the reference environment.
Require every changed environment to use category_extension and a 60–69 score.
Count plural work areas and generic furniture/furnishings as background details unless they are the explicit support surface.
Require clause-level additions, deletions and substitutions in ctech_changes and forbid claims that absent reference lighting was retained.
